toggleLabel: Show the SprintPlus WebSprinter read-aloud software

tutorial.title: SprintPlus WebSprinter
tutorial.content:
The SprintPlus WebSprinter is a read-aloud software that can read the content of web pages.
You can enable or disable the WebSprinter via the accessibility settings on the left or via the keyboard shortcut ALT+S.

package.title: Adds SprintPlus accessibility toggle
package.description: Adds a toggle switch to the user's accessibility settings for enabling/disabling the SprintPlus WebSprinter UI.
